verdict.rationale: telli documents call outcome fields on each call (telli-docs-8) and webhooks that POST call events, status changes, and outcomes to your endpoint in real time (telli-docs-13, telli-docs-21), which covers post-call delivery of structured outcomes and dispositions. Captured entities appear only indirectly, through 'collected values' used in workflows (telli-docs-5) and appointment data saved during calls (telli-docs-2). Missing for 10: documentation for defining a custom extraction schema, a documented REST endpoint for retrieving post-call structured data, an example webhook payload showing entities and outcomes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
